answer: Duplicate identities cost double the stake plus wasted compute, and a shared atlas of verified agents cross-checks fingerprints so copies get slashed. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and solve a unique proof-of-work tied to its identity, like carving a distinct sonnet into a dune that shifts if reused. Adversaries face escalating deposits and reputation loss, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0199's threat model.
